theme_strategy: Persisted Light/Dark mode with toggle in header. Professional, high-density enterprise dashboard.

rules.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
rules.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200
rules.labels: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

status_badges.open: bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border dark:border-rose-500/20
status_badges.monitoring: bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border dark:border-amber-500/20
status_badges.pending: bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 dark:bg-orange-500/10 dark:text-orange-400 dark:border dark:border-orange-500/20
status_badges.resolved: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border dark:border-emerald-500/20

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid backgrounds. NO glassmorphism to ensure data legibility. NO shadows in dark mode. Minimal soft shadows (shadow-sm) in light mode.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using the defined border colors. Crisp, structural edges.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. Use rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) for cards, buttons, and inputs. Avoid full pill shapes except for small status badges.

layouts.global: Collapsible Sidebar on left. Top Header. Main content area. Mobile-first responsive grid structure.
layouts.header: Contains global search, notifications bell, theme toggle, and user profile dropdown. Must have solid background and 1px bottom border. NO transparent backgrounds.
layouts.sidebar: Solid background. Collapsible state shows only icons. Highlight active route with subtle primary tint.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Use clickable stat cards at the top level.
layouts.spacing: Use Tailwind p-4, p-6. Ensure containers with borders have adequate internal padding.

components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn UI based. Use Drawers (Sheets) or Modals (Dialogs) for CRUD forms to avoid navigating away from main tables.
components.tables: Modern responsive tables (Shadcn Table). Sticky headers, hover rows, pagination, and action dropdowns on the right side. Include Skeleton loaders for data fetching states.
components.buttons: Standard rectangular with rounded-md. Avoid excessive padding. Clear hover/active states.
components.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications. Position bottom-right.
components.empty_states: Centered soft text with a muted icon and a primary action button.
components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for Customer Categories (Broadband, Dedicated, etc.) and Document Types.

motion.rules: Minimalist and professional. transition-colors duration-200 for hover states. Simple fade-in for modals/drawers. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark mode text must not be pure white (use #F8FAFC).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='theme-toggle-button').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-1) on all inputs/buttons.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5 or 2. Clean, professional look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create files in .js and .jsx formats only. DO NOT use .tsx or TypeScript.
Implement a fully functional Light/Dark theme toggle using Tailwind's 'dark' class and save preference in localStorage.
The login page should be elegant and simple, using a centered card or professional split layout without consumer marketing fluff.
Implement JWT logic in the frontend with context or standard state management.
Mock the initial NOC data (Customers, Documents, Logs, Stats) to populate the dashboard and tables based on the requested features.
Implement file upload logic simulating Base64 conversion before sending to the backend.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never use transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or overlays. Always use solid colors in this enterprise app.
Avoid generic AI slop. Stick strictly to the defined color palette and flat enterprise design. Emphasize readability and information density.
Ensure all tables scroll horizontally on small screens without breaking the overall layout.
Use Shadcn primitives heavily but strip any styling that conflicts with the enterprise NOC requirements.
